num_customers: <int> Number of customers whose demand must be satisfied.
capacity_factor: <float> Ratio of total facility capacity to total expected demand, controlling how tight capacity is.
variance_level: <str> Level of demand variability across scenarios ('normal' or 'high').

facilities.opening_cost: <float> Fixed cost incurred if this facility is opened.
facilities.capacity: <float> Maximum total units this facility can ship across all customers in any scenario.
facilities.location_x: <float> X-coordinate of the facility location, used to compute transportation costs.
facilities.location_y: <float> Y-coordinate of the facility location, used to compute transportation costs.

customers.demand_std_fraction: <float> Ratio of demand standard deviation to mean demand for this customer.
customers.location_x: <float> X-coordinate of the customer location, used to compute transportation costs.
customers.location_y: <float> Y-coordinate of the customer location, used to compute transportation costs.

transportation_costs: <list[list[float]], shape [num_facilities][num_customers]> Per-unit cost of shipping from each facility to each customer, equal to the Euclidean distance between them.

scenarios.demands: <list[float], length num_customers> Realized demand of each customer under this scenario.
